Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateContext(
    {
        locSelectedAccount: Blank(),
        locSelectedCapexAccountCategory: tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected,
        locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: true,
        locSpinnerInformationText: "Please wait, loading cost ..."
    }
);
ClearCollect(
    colSubaccountMappedCostPaid,
    ShowColumns(
        Filter(
            'SPVDevCo Mapping Capex Devexes',
            'Account Number' in colCapexSubaccountsInSelectedCategoryNew.Number
        ),
        'Account Number',
        'DevCo/SPV'
    )
);
/*
ClearCollect(
    colCapexCostsInSelectedContracts,
    Filter(
        colCapexCosts,
        Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' in colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory.'CAPEX Project Contract'
    )
);*/


ClearCollect(
    colCombinedCostAccounts,
    ShowColumns(
        RenameColumns(
            AddColumns(
                Filter(
                    colAllGroupedAccounts,
                    vsb_AccountCategory = tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected.'CAPEX Account List'
                ),
                r_RelatedRowID,
                vsb_capexaccountlistid,
                s_Year,
                Year(Today()),
                c_Description,
                If(
                    IsAccount,
                    "*Account*"
                )
            ),
            vsb_number,
            a_Number,
            vsb_name,
            b_Name
        ),
        a_Number,
        b_Name,
        c_Description,
        r_RelatedRowID,
        s_Year
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colAddCostFromTable,
    Ungroup(
        ForAll(
            colCombinedCostAccounts As MainRow,
            Table(
                MainRow,
                With(
                    {
                        locCostGroupedByContracts: GroupBy(
                            SortByColumns(
                                AddColumns(
                                    ShowColumns(
                                        Filter(
                                            colCapexCostsInSelectedContracts,
                                            Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' in Filter(
                                                colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory,
                                                Account.'CAPEX Account List' = MainRow.r_RelatedRowID
                                            ).'CAPEX Project Contract'
                                        ),
                                        Cost,
                                        Contract,
                                        Month,
                                        Year
                                    ),
                                    ContractID,
                                    vsb_Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract',
                                    ContractName,
                                    vsb_Contract.Name,
                                    createdON,
                                    vsb_Contract.'Created On'
                                ),
                                "ContractName",
                                SortOrder.Ascending
                            ),
                            ContractID,
                            vsb_year,
                            ByYear
                        )
                    },
                    ForAll(
                        locCostGroupedByContracts As Cost,
                        With(
                            {
                                locContract: LookUp(
                                    colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory,
                                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = Cost.ContractID
                                )
                            },
                            {
                                a_Number: ""/*MainRow.a_Number*/,
                                b_Name: ""/*MainRow.b_Name*/,
                                c_Description: locContract.Name,
                                d_costpaidby: If(
                                    locContract.'Cost Type' = 'Cost paid type'.DevCo,
                                    "DevCo",
                                    locContract.'Cost Type' = 'Cost paid type'.SPV,
                                    "SPV",
                                    "DevCo"
                                ),
                                e_depreciation: If(
                                    locContract.'Depreciation?' = 'Depreciation? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes,
                                    "Yes",
                                    locContract.'Depreciation?' = 'Depreciation? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No,
                                    "No",
                                    "No"
                                ),
                                f_applyVAT: If(
                                    locContract.'Apply VAT?' = 'Apply VAT? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes,
                                    "Yes",
                                    locContract.'Apply VAT?' = 'Apply VAT? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No,
                                    "No",
                                    "No"
                                ),
                                g_Jan: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].January
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                h_Feb: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].February
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                i_Mar: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].March
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                j_Apr: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].April
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                k_May: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].May
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                l_Jun: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].June
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                m_Jul: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].July
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                n_Aug: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].August
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                o_Sep: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].September
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                p_Oct: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].October
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                q_Nov: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].November
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                r_Dec: LookUp(
                                    Cost.ByYear,
                                    vsb_month = [@Month].December
                                ).vsb_cost,
                                s_ID: Cost.ContractID,
                                t_parentId: LookUp(
                                    colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory,
                                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = Cost.ContractID
                                ).Account.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List',
                                u_RelatedRowID: Cost.ContractID,
                                v_Year: Cost.vsb_year,
                                w_isStandardContract: If(
                                    locContract.'Is Standard Contract?' = 'Is Standard Contract? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Ja,
                                    true,
                                    false
                                )
                            }
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        Value
    )
);
// this is for change and test
Set(
    varPCFInputData,
    JSON(colAddCostFromTable)
);
Navigate(
    'Add Costs from Table',
    ScreenTransition.None,
    {
        lclCopyTable: true,
        locSaveData: true,
        lcladdrow: true,
        //lcldeleterow: true,
        locVisibleSubAccountsError: false,
        locShowErrorsInList: false,
        locTimerEnd: false,
        locTimerStart: false,
        locPCFJsonInput: varPCFInputData,
        locSpinnerInformationText: "",
        locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
        lcltglShowCostEnabled: 
        //Changed for Hotfix to Prod false was original
true,
        locProjectStartingYear: Text(locCostAllowedStartYear),
        locEndingYear: Text(
            Coalesce(
                Value(
                    Text(
                        gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
                        "yyyy"
                    )
                ) + 3,
                2050
            )
        ),
        locSelectedTglTab: tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected
    }
);

Rules.InvariantScript:
Filter(
    colFinatCostDataOptimized,
    Or(
        IsContract && vsb_year = gblSelectedProjectYear,
        Not(IsContract) && IsBlank(vsb_year)
    ),
    (tgl_Costs_ProjectCosts_TableCommandBar_ShowInactiveAccounts.Checked) || vsb_statusbool || LookUp(
        colCapexSubaccountsInSelectedCategoryNew,
        'CAPEX Account List' = vsb_parentaccountid
    ).Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Active,
    vsb_AccountCategory = tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected.'CAPEX Account List'
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 1, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 1, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 2, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 2, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 3, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 3, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 4, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 4, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 5, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 5, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

Date(
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 6, StartYear), locNavigationMinYear, gblSelectedProjectYear),
    Coalesce(LookUp(gblClusterDurations, Order = 6, StartMonth), 1),
    1
)

UpdateContext(
    {
        locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: true,
        locSpinnerInformationText: "Please wait, saving..."
    }
);
With(
    {
        varSelectedMonthChoice: Switch(
            Value(DevexCapexSummaryPCF.SelectedCostMonth),
            1,
            [@Month].January,
            2,
            [@Month].February,
            3,
            [@Month].March,
            4,
            [@Month].April,
            5,
            [@Month].May,
            6,
            [@Month].June,
            7,
            [@Month].July,
            8,
            [@Month].August,
            9,
            [@Month].September,
            10,
            [@Month].October,
            11,
            [@Month].November,
            12,
            [@Month].December
        ),
        varCostInSelectedContract: Filter(
            'CAPEX Costs',
            Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = GUID(DevexCapexSummaryPCF.SelectedCostContractId)
        )
    },
    With(
        {
            varCostRecord: LookUp(
                varCostInSelectedContract,
                And(
                    Year = Value(DevexCapexSummaryPCF.SelectedCostYear),
                    Month = Switch(
                        Value(DevexCapexSummaryPCF.SelectedCostMonth),
                        1,
                        [@Month].January,
                        2,
                        [@Month].February,
                        3,
                        [@Month].March,
                        4,
                        [@Month].April,
                        5,
                        [@Month].May,
                        6,
                        [@Month].June,
                        7,
                        [@Month].July,
                        8,
                        [@Month].August,
                        9,
                        [@Month].September,
                        10,
                        [@Month].October,
                        11,
                        [@Month].November,
                        12,
                        [@Month].December
                    )
                )
            )
        },
        If(
            IsBlank(varCostRecord),
            Notify(
                "No monthly cost row found for selected contract/month/year.",
                NotificationType.Warning,
                gblAppConstants.NotifyTimeOut
            ),
            IfError(
                Patch(
                    'CAPEX Costs',
                    varCostRecord,
                    {'Cost Paid': DevexCapexSummaryPCF.SelectedCostPaid}
                );
                Refresh('CAPEX Costs');
                Select(btn_Capex_Cost_Reload_PCF_After_Mutation_Code),
                Notify(
                    "Could not update paid status. Please refresh and try again.",
                    NotificationType.Error,
                    gblAppConstants.NotifyTimeOut
                )
            )
        )
    )
);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
        locSpinnerInformationText: ""
    }
)

Text(
    ThisItem.Sum,
    "###,###,###,##0"
) & $" {If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')),
    gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code',
    "EUR"
)}"

Text(Max(Sum(gal_Costs_ContentCostsSummary.AllItems, Sum),0), "###,###,###,##0") & $" {If(
    Not(IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code')),
    gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'ISO Currency Code',
    "EUR"
)}"

)

Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    {
        varStartClusterNo: Coalesce(
            locProjectStartClusterNo,
            Switch(
                Coalesce(
                    gblSelectedProject.'Start Cluster',
                    'Cluster States'.Greenfield
                ),
                'Cluster States'.Greenfield, 0,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1', 1,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2', 2,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3', 3,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4', 4,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5', 5,
                'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6', 6,
                0
            )
        )
    },
    Ungroup(
        Table(
            {vsb_name: "None"},
            Sort(
                Filter(
                    'Project States',
                    Order in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] &&
                    Order > gblSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Order &&
                    Order >= Max(1, varStartClusterNo)
                ),
                Order,
                SortOrder.Ascending
            )
        ),
        Name
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value,
                    0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_24.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value,
                    0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_25.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value,
                   0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value ='Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_26.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value,
                    0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_27.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value,
                    0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_29.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value,
                   0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_30.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value,
                   0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_32.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value =
    'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values'
    ,
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value,
                    0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_33.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsInteger(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be a numeric",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value,
                   0,
                    If(
                        gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                        2250000000,
                        500000000
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and {If(
            gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
            2250000000,
            500000000
        )}."
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value)),
            Not(fn_Numeric_CC.IsOneDecimal(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value))
        ),
        $"Value must be numeric upto one decimal",
        And(
            IsNumeric(txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value),
            Not(
                fn_Numeric_CC.InRange(
                    txt_Costs_RightPanel_EditCostsInSubaccount_BodyContent_FirstMonth_35.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            )
        ),
        $"Value must be between 0 and 100."
    )
)

If(
    And(
        //Not(cmp_ShowErrorInContract.Visible),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_Description_1.Value)),

        Not(lbl_GeneratorData_RightPanel_Form_PvModuleType_Fields_Label_ErrorMessage_2.Visible),
        Not(IsBlank(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value)),
        If(
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value))
            ),
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
            Not(IsBlank(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value)),
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Equal Distribution',
            And(
                If(
                    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1.Selected.Value = "By Cluster",
                    Or(
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit,
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster2_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster2_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit,
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster3_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster3_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit,
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster4_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster4_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit,
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster5_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster5_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit
                    ),
                    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1.Selected.Value = "By Start and End Date",
                    And(
                        Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_1.Value)),
                        Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_1.Value)),
                        Not(lbl_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
                        Not(lbl_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_ErrorMessage_1.Visible)
                    )
                ),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_AddContract_RightPanel_PaymentFrequency_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value))
            )
        ),
        locEditSaveButtonEnabled
        /*,
        If(
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution',
            Round(
                Sum(
                    colNewEditPanelCost,
                    ThisRecord.Jan + ThisRecord.Feb + ThisRecord.Mar + ThisRecord.Apr + ThisRecord.May + ThisRecord.Jun + ThisRecord.Jul + ThisRecord.Aug + ThisRecord.Sep + ThisRecord.Oct + ThisRecord.Nov + ThisRecord.Dec
                ),
                1
            ) = 100,
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolut Values' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution',
            Sum(
                colNewEditPanelCost,
                ThisRecord.Jan + ThisRecord.Feb + ThisRecord.Mar + ThisRecord.Apr + ThisRecord.May + ThisRecord.Jun + ThisRecord.Jul + ThisRecord.Aug + ThisRecord.Sep + ThisRecord.Oct + ThisRecord.Nov + ThisRecord.Dec
            ) = Value(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value),
            true
        )*/
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

                    colCapexProjectContracts,
                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid

                                5,
                                [@Month].May,
                                6,
                                [@Month].June,
                                7,
                                [@Month].July,
                                8,
                                [@Month].August,
                                9,
                                [@Month].September,
                                10,
                                [@Month].October,
                                11,
                                [@Month].November,
                                12,
                                [@Month].December
                            ),
                            'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)'
                        }
                    )
                ),
                Trace(
                    "Error While Trying to Patch Data to Capex Cost: " & Concat(
                        AllErrors,
                        Message,
                        ", "
                    ),// <--- Concatenates all messages
                    TraceSeverity.Error
                );
                Notify(
                    "Something went wrong saving the Capex data. Please refresh the page and verify your changes were saved correctly.",
                    NotificationType.Error,
                    5000// Keeps it on screen for 10 seconds so they can read it
                )
            );
            Patch(
                'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                LookUp(
                    colCapexProjectContracts,
                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
                ),
                {
                    'Average Payment': RoundDown(
                        txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value / locNumPayments,
                        0
                    ),
                    'Linked Cluster': If(
                        drp_Add_Edit_Cost_Data_RightPanel_Form_Link_to_Cluster.Selected.Name <> "None",
                        drp_Add_Edit_Cost_Data_RightPanel_Form_Link_to_Cluster.Selected,
                        Blank()
                    )
                }
            );
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                //locSelectedAccount: Blank(),
                locSelectedCapexAccountCategory: tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected,
                locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: true,
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank(),
                locShowInActive: false,
                locChangedByDate: false,
                locChangedDistribution: false,
                locClusterChanged: false,
                locChangedFrequency: false
            }
        );
        If(
            CountIf(
                colCapexProjectContracts,
                'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            ) > 0,
            Concurrent(
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexProjectContracts,
                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                ,
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexCosts,
                    Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                ,
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
                    vsb_capexaccountlistid = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                RemoveIf(
                    colReference,
                    ContractId = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
            );
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexProjectContracts,
            LookUp(
                'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexCosts,
            Filter(
                'CAPEX Costs',
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory,
            Filter(
                colCapexProjectContracts,
                Account.'CAPEX Account List' in colCapexSubaccountsInSelectedCategoryNew.'CAPEX Account List'
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colCapexCostsInSelectedContracts,
            Filter(
                colCapexCosts,
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' in colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colReference,
            ForAll(
                Sequence(
                    Max(
                        Year(gblSelectedProject.'End Date') - Year(gblSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'),
                        15
                    ),
                    Year(gblSelectedProject.'Project Start Date')
                ),
                {
                    ContractId: locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract',
                    vsb_year: Value
                }
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
            ForAll(
                Filter(
                    colReference,
                    ThisRecord.ContractId = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                ) As Item,
                With(
                    {
                        locContract: LookUp(
                            colCapexProjectContracts,
                            'CAPEX Project Contract' = Item.ContractId
                        )
                    },
                    With(
                        {
                            locMainAccount: LookUp(
                                colCapexAccountsNew,
                                'CAPEX Account List' = locContract.Account.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                            )
                        },
                        {
                            vsb_costdescription: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.Name
                            ),
                            vsb_parentaccountid: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.Account.'CAPEX Account List'
                            ),
                            IsAccount: false,
                            IsContract: true,
                            vsb_capexaccountlistid: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                            ),
                            vsb_year: Item.vsb_year,
                            vsb_statusbool: If(
                                locContract.Account.Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Active,
                                true,
                                locContract.Account.Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Inactive,
                                false
                            ),
                            vsb_CreatedOn: locContract.'Created On',
                            vsb_AccountCategory: locMainAccount.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                        }
                    )
                )
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colFinatCostDataOptimized,
            Ungroup(
                ForAll(
                    colAllGroupedAccounts As Item,
                    Table(
                        Item,
                        SortByColumns(
                            Filter(
                                colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
                                vsb_parentaccountid = Item.vsb_capexaccountlistid
                            ),
                            "vsb_costdescription",
                            SortOrder.Ascending
                        )
                    )
                ),
                Value
            )
        );
        UpdateContext({locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: false});
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
                locSpinnerInformationText: "",
                locShowErrorInContractCost: false,
                locAllYearsCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedContractDescription: "",
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank()
            }
        );
        Concurrent(
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_AverageAmountPerPayment_1),
            Reset(drp_AddContract_RightPanel_PaymentFrequency_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_CostPaidBy_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_Description_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1),
            Reset(tgl_AddContract_RightPanel_ApplyVAT_1),
            Reset(tgl_AddContract_RightPanel_Depreciation_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster2_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster3_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster4_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster5_1)
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locAllYearsCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedContractDescription: "",
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank(),
                locSelectedProjectContract: Blank()
            }
        );
        Clear(colOtherClusterHavingCost)
    );
    
);

            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
            Not(IsBlank(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value)),
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Equal Distribution',
            And(
                If(
                    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1.Selected.Value = "By Cluster",
                    Or(
                        chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1.Checked && chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1.DisplayMode=DisplayMode.Edit,

                    ),
                    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1.Selected.Value = "By Start and End Date",
                    And(
                        Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_1.Value)),
                        Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_1.Value)),
                        Not(lbl_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),

                    )
                ),
                Not(IsBlank(drp_AddContract_RightPanel_PaymentFrequency_1.Selected.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value))
            )
        ),
        locEditSaveButtonEnabled

        If(
            rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values' && rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution',
            Round(
                Sum(

            Sum(

            ) = Value(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value),
            true
        )*/
    ),

    DisplayMode.Disabled

                rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1.Selected.Value = "By Start and End Date",
                ClearCollect(
                    colSelectedClusters,
                    {
                        Cluster: 1,
                        Start: txt_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_1.Value,
                        End: txt_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_1.Value
                    }
                )
            );
            ClearCollect(
                colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                Ungroup(
                    ForAll(
                        colSelectedClusters As cluster,
                        With(
                            {
                                locStartDateParts: Split(
                                    cluster.Start,
                                    "/"
                                ),
                                locEndDateParts: Split(
                                    cluster.End,
                                    "/"
                                ),
                                locTotalCost: txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value
                            },
                            With(
                                {
                                    locStartMonth: First(locStartDateParts).Value,
                                    locStartYear: Last(locStartDateParts).Value,
                                    locEndMonth: First(locEndDateParts).Value,
                                    locEndYear: Last(locEndDateParts).Value,
                                    locFrequency: drp_AddContract_RightPanel_PaymentFrequency_1.Selected.Value
                                },
                                With(
                                    {
                                        numPayments: RoundDown(
                                            Max(
                                                (locEndYear - locStartYear) * 12 + (locEndMonth - locStartMonth),
                                                0
                                            ) / Coalesce(
                                                locFrequency,
                                                1
                                            ),
                                            0
                                        ) + 1
                                    },
                                    ForAll(
                                        Sequence(numPayments),
                                        {
                                            'CAPEX Cost': Defaults('CAPEX Costs'),
                                            Contract: locSelectedProjectContract,
                                            //Cost: ,
                                            Year: locStartYear + RoundDown(
                                                (locStartMonth - 1 + (ThisRecord.Value - 1) * locFrequency) / 12,
                                                0
                                            ),
                                            Month: Mod(
                                                locStartMonth - 1 + (ThisRecord.Value - 1) * locFrequency,
                                                12
                                            ) + 1
                                        }
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                    Value
                )
            );
            ClearCollect(
                colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                ForAll(
                    Distinct(
                        colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                        ThisRecord
                    ),
                    ThisRecord.Value
                )
            );
            UpdateContext(
                {
                    locNumPayments: CountIf(
                        colCapexCostDataToPatch,
                        true
                    ),
                    locLastCost: Last(colCapexCostDataToPatch),
                    locTotalCost: txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value
                }
            );
            RemoveIf(
                'CAPEX Costs',
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            );
            IfError(
                Patch(
                    'CAPEX Costs',
                    ForAll(
                        colCapexCostDataToPatch As Item,
                        {
                            'CAPEX Cost': Item.'CAPEX Cost'.'CAPEX Cost',
                            Contract: Item.Contract,
                            Name: Item.Contract.Name,
                            Year: Item.Year,
                            Cost: If(
                                Item.Month = locLastCost.Month && Item.Year = locLastCost.Year,
                                txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value - (RoundDown(
                                    txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value / locNumPayments,
                                    0
                                ))*(locNumPayments - 1),
                                RoundDown(
                                    txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value / locNumPayments,
                                    0
                                )
                            ),
                            Month: Switch(
                                Item.Month,
                                1,
                                [@Month].January,
                                2,
                                [@Month].February,
                                3,
                                [@Month].March,
                                4,
                                [@Month].April,
                                5,
                                [@Month].May,
                                6,
                                [@Month].June,
                                7,
                                [@Month].July,
                                8,
                                [@Month].August,
                                9,
                                [@Month].September,
                                10,
                                [@Month].October,
                                11,
                                [@Month].November,
                                12,
                                [@Month].December
                            ),
                            'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)'
                        }
                    )
                ),
                Trace(
                    "Error While Trying to Patch Data to Capex Cost: " & Concat(
                        AllErrors,
                        Message,
                        ", "
                    ),// <--- Concatenates all messages
                    TraceSeverity.Error
                );
                Notify(
                    "Something went wrong saving the Capex data. Please refresh the page and verify your changes were saved correctly.",
                    NotificationType.Error,
                    5000// Keeps it on screen for 10 seconds so they can read it
                )
            );
            Patch(
                'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                LookUp(
                    colCapexProjectContracts,
                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
                ),
                {
                    'Average Payment': RoundDown(
                        txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1.Value / locNumPayments,
                        0
                    ),
                    'Linked Cluster': If(
                        drp_Add_Edit_Cost_Data_RightPanel_Form_Link_to_Cluster.Selected.Name <> "None",
                        drp_Add_Edit_Cost_Data_RightPanel_Form_Link_to_Cluster.Selected,
                        Blank()
                    )
                }
            );
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                //locSelectedAccount: Blank(),
                locSelectedCapexAccountCategory: tab_Costs_ContentAssignableAccountCategories.Selected,
                locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: true,
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank(),
                locShowInActive: false,
                locChangedByDate: false,
                locChangedDistribution: false,
                locClusterChanged: false,
                locChangedFrequency: false
            }
        );
        If(
            CountIf(
                colCapexProjectContracts,
                'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            ) > 0,
            Concurrent(
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexProjectContracts,
                    'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                ,
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexCosts,
                    Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                ,
                RemoveIf(
                    colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
                    vsb_capexaccountlistid = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
                RemoveIf(
                    colReference,
                    ContractId = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                );
            );
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexProjectContracts,
            LookUp(
                'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexCosts,
            Filter(
                'CAPEX Costs',
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory,
            Filter(
                colCapexProjectContracts,
                Account.'CAPEX Account List' in colCapexSubaccountsInSelectedCategoryNew.'CAPEX Account List'
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colCapexCostsInSelectedContracts,
            Filter(
                colCapexCosts,
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' in colCapexContractsInSelectedCategory.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colReference,
            ForAll(
                Sequence(
                    Max(
                        Year(
                            Coalesce(
                                gblSelectedProject.'End Date',
                                gblSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
                                Today()
                            )
                        ) - locCostAllowedStartYear,
                        15
                    ),
                    locCostAllowedStartYear
                ),
                {
                    ContractId: locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract',
                    vsb_year: Value
                }
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
            ForAll(
                Filter(
                    colReference,
                    ThisRecord.ContractId = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                ) As Item,
                With(
                    {
                        locContract: LookUp(
                            colCapexProjectContracts,
                            'CAPEX Project Contract' = Item.ContractId
                        )
                    },
                    With(
                        {
                            locMainAccount: LookUp(
                                colCapexAccountsNew,
                                'CAPEX Account List' = locContract.Account.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                            )
                        },
                        {
                            vsb_costdescription: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.Name
                            ),
                            vsb_parentaccountid: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.Account.'CAPEX Account List'
                            ),
                            IsAccount: false,
                            IsContract: true,
                            vsb_capexaccountlistid: If(
                                IsBlank(locContract),
                                Blank(),
                                locContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                            ),
                            vsb_year: Item.vsb_year,
                            vsb_statusbool: If(
                                locContract.Account.Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Active,
                                true,
                                locContract.Account.Status = 'Status (CAPEX Account Lists)'.Inactive,
                                false
                            ),
                            vsb_CreatedOn: locContract.'Created On',
                            vsb_AccountCategory: locMainAccount.'Parent Account'.'CAPEX Account List'
                        }
                    )
                )
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colFinatCostDataOptimized,
            Ungroup(
                ForAll(
                    colAllGroupedAccounts As Item,
                    Table(
                        Item,
                        SortByColumns(
                            Filter(
                                colCapexContractCostGrouped_V1,
                                vsb_parentaccountid = Item.vsb_capexaccountlistid
                            ),
                            "vsb_costdescription",
                            SortOrder.Ascending
                        )
                    )
                ),
                Value
            )
        );
        UpdateContext({locIsVisibleLoadingCostSpinner: false});
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locIsVisiblePopUpSpinner: false,
                locSpinnerInformationText: "",
                locShowErrorInContractCost: false,
                locAllYearsCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedContractDescription: "",
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank()
            }
        );
        Concurrent(
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_AverageAmountPerPayment_1),
            Reset(drp_AddContract_RightPanel_PaymentFrequency_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_CostPaidBy_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionBy_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1),
            Reset(rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionType_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_Description_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_EndDate_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_StartDate_1),
            Reset(txt_AddContract_RightPanel_TotalCost_1),
            Reset(tgl_AddContract_RightPanel_ApplyVAT_1),
            Reset(tgl_AddContract_RightPanel_Depreciation_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster1_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster2_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster3_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster4_1),
            Reset(chk_AddContract_RightPanel_SelectCluster5_1)
        );
        UpdateContext(
            {
                locAllYearsCost: Blank(),
                locSelectedContractDescription: "",
                locSelectedCostRow: Blank()
            }
        );
        Clear(colOtherClusterHavingCost)
    );
    
);
