Rules.InvariantScript:
// ensure these are set (from your original code)
UpdateContext({locStartBinding: false});
UpdateContext(
    {
        locAllYearsCost: Coalesce(
            locSelectedProjectContract.'Total Cost',
            Sum(
                Filter(
                    colCapexCostsInSelectedContracts,
                    Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                ),
                Cost
            )
        )
    }
);
// prefetch for speed (your existing lookups)
With(
    {
        locFilteredCostData: ShowColumns(
            Filter(
                colCapexCosts,
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
            ),
            Month,
            Cost,
            Year
        ),
        locContract: LookUp(
            colCapexProjectContracts,
            'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
        )
    },
    With(
        {schemeIsPct: locContract.'Distribution Scheme' = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values'},
  // iterate each year once and fill both UI & Save + totals
        ClearCollect(
            colNewEditPanelCost,
            ForAll(
                Sequence(locProjectDuration) As Y,
                With(
                    {yr: locProjectStartyear + Y.Value},
                    With(
                        {
                            // existing absolute month amounts from your local cache
                            mJan: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 1 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mFeb: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 2 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mMar: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 3 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mApr: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 4 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mMay: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 5 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mJun: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 6 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mJul: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 7 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mAug: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 8 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mSep: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 9 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mOct: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 10 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mNov: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 11 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mDec: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 12 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost
                        },
                        With(
                            {
                                // UI values: if % scheme → UI is percent (1 dec); else → absolute = mX
                                JanUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJan),
                                        Round(
                                            mJan / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mJan,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                FebUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mFeb),
                                        Round(
                                            mFeb / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mFeb,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                MarUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mMar),
                                        Round(
                                            mMar / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mMar,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                AprUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mApr),
                                        Round(
                                            mApr / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mApr,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                MayUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mMay),
                                        Round(
                                            mMay / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mMay,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                JunUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJun),
                                        Round(
                                            mJun / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mJun,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                JulUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJul),
                                        Round(
                                            mJul / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mJul,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                AugUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mAug),
                                        Round(
                                            mAug / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mAug,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                SepUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mSep),
                                        Round(
                                            mSep / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mSep,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                OctUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mOct),
                                        Round(
                                            mOct / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mOct,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                NovUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mNov),
                                        Round(
                                            mNov / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mNov,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                DecUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mDec),
                                        Round(
                                            mDec / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Round(
                                        mDec,
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                // Save values (absolute): when we are loading existing rows, Save = existing absolute mX
                                JanSv: mJan,
                                FebSv: mFeb,
                                MarSv: mMar,
                                AprSv: mApr,
                                MaySv: mMay,
                                JunSv: mJun,
                                JulSv: mJul,
                                AugSv: mAug,
                                SepSv: mSep,
                                OctSv: mOct,
                                NovSv: mNov,
                                DecSv: mDec
                            },
                            With(
                                {
                                    newTotalUI: Sum(
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JanUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            FebUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MarUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AprUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MayUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JunUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JulUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AugUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            SepUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            OctUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            NovUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            DecUIv,
                                            0
                                        )
                                    ),
                                    newTotalSave: Sum(
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JanSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            FebSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MarSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AprSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MaySv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JunSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JulSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AugSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            SepSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            OctSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            NovSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            DecSv,
                                            0
                                        )
                                    )
                                },
                                {
                                    Year: yr,
                                    IsFolded: true,
                                    IsValid: true,
                                    JanUI: JanUIv,
                                    FebUI: FebUIv,
                                    MarUI: MarUIv,
                                    AprUI: AprUIv,
                                    MayUI: MayUIv,
                                    JunUI: JunUIv,
                                    JulUI: JulUIv,
                                    AugUI: AugUIv,
                                    SepUI: SepUIv,
                                    OctUI: OctUIv,
                                    NovUI: NovUIv,
                                    DecUI: DecUIv,
                                    JanSave: JanSv,
                                    FebSave: FebSv,
                                    MarSave: MarSv,
                                    AprSave: AprSv,
                                    MaySave: MaySv,
                                    JunSave: JunSv,
                                    JulSave: JulSv,
                                    AugSave: AugSv,
                                    SepSave: SepSv,
                                    OctSave: OctSv,
                                    NovSave: NovSv,
                                    DecSave: DecSv,
                                    TotalUI: newTotalUI,
                                    TotalSave: newTotalSave
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
);
// stop the timer

        locFilteredCostData: ShowColumns(
            Filter(
                colCapexCosts,
                Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
            ),
            Month,
            Cost,
            Year
        ),
        locContract: LookUp(
            colCapexProjectContracts,
            'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedCostRow.vsb_capexaccountlistid
        )
    },
    With(
        {schemeIsPct: locContract.'Distribution Scheme' = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values'},
  // iterate each year once and fill both UI & Save + totals
        ClearCollect(
            colNewEditPanelCost,
            ForAll(
                Sequence(locProjectDuration) As Y,
                With(
                    {yr: locProjectStartyear + Y.Value},
                    With(
                        {
                            // existing absolute month amounts from your local cache
                            mJan: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 1 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mFeb: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 2 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mMar: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 3 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mApr: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 4 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mMay: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 5 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mJun: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 6 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mJul: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 7 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mAug: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 8 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mSep: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 9 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mOct: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 10 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mNov: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 11 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost,
                            mDec: LookUp(
                                locFilteredCostData,
                                vsb_month = 12 && vsb_year = yr
                            ).vsb_cost
                        },
                        With(
                            {
                                // UI values: if % scheme → UI is percent (1 dec); else → absolute = mX
                                JanUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJan),
                                        Round(
                                            mJan / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mJan
                                ),
                                FebUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mFeb),
                                        Round(
                                            mFeb / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mFeb
                                ),
                                MarUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mMar),
                                        Round(
                                            mMar / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mMar
                                ),
                                AprUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mApr),
                                        Round(
                                            mApr / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mApr
                                ),
                                MayUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mMay),
                                        Round(
                                            mMay / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mMay
                                ),
                                JunUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJun),
                                        Round(
                                            mJun / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mJun
                                ),
                                JulUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mJul),
                                        Round(
                                            mJul / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mJul
                                ),
                                AugUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mAug),
                                        Round(
                                            mAug / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mAug
                                ),
                                SepUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mSep),
                                        Round(
                                            mSep / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mSep
                                ),
                                OctUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mOct),
                                        Round(
                                            mOct / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mOct
                                ),
                                NovUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mNov),
                                        Round(
                                            mNov / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mNov
                                ),
                                DecUIv: If(
                                    schemeIsPct,
                                    If(
                                        !IsBlank(mDec),
                                        Round(
                                            mDec / locContract.'Total Cost' * 100,
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    mDec
                                ),
                                // Save values (absolute): when we are loading existing rows, Save = existing absolute mX
                                JanSv: mJan,
                                FebSv: mFeb,
                                MarSv: mMar,
                                AprSv: mApr,
                                MaySv: mMay,
                                JunSv: mJun,
                                JulSv: mJul,
                                AugSv: mAug,
                                SepSv: mSep,
                                OctSv: mOct,
                                NovSv: mNov,
                                DecSv: mDec
                            },
                            With(
                                {
                                    newTotalUI: Sum(
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JanUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            FebUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MarUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AprUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MayUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JunUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JulUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AugUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            SepUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            OctUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            NovUIv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            DecUIv,
                                            0
                                        )
                                    ),
                                    newTotalSave: Sum(
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JanSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            FebSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MarSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AprSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            MaySv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JunSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            JulSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            AugSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            SepSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            OctSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            NovSv,
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        Coalesce(
                                            DecSv,
                                            0
                                        )
                                    )
                                },
                                {
                                    Year: yr,
                                    IsFolded: true,
                                    IsValid: true,
                                    JanUI: JanUIv,
                                    FebUI: FebUIv,
                                    MarUI: MarUIv,
                                    AprUI: AprUIv,
                                    MayUI: MayUIv,
                                    JunUI: JunUIv,
                                    JulUI: JulUIv,
                                    AugUI: AugUIv,
                                    SepUI: SepUIv,
                                    OctUI: OctUIv,
                                    NovUI: NovUIv,
                                    DecUI: DecUIv,
                                    JanSave: JanSv,
                                    FebSave: FebSv,
                                    MarSave: MarSv,
                                    AprSave: AprSv,
                                    MaySave: MaySv,
                                    JunSave: JunSv,
                                    JulSave: JulSv,
                                    AugSave: AugSv,
                                    SepSave: SepSv,
                                    OctSave: OctSv,
                                    NovSave: NovSv,
                                    DecSave: DecSv,
                                    TotalUI: newTotalUI,
                                    TotalSave: newTotalSave
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
);

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'% Values',
    If(
        Sum(
            ForAll(
                colNewEditPanelCost,
                TotalUI
            ),
            Value
        ) > 100,
        $"Total percentage is over 100%",
        Sum(
            ForAll(
                colNewEditPanelCost,
                TotalUI
            ),
            Value
        ) < 100,
        $"Total percentage is below 100%"
    ),
    rad_AddContract_RightPanel_DistributionScheme_1.Selected.Value = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values' && Sum(
        ForAll(
            colNewEditPanelCost,
            TotalSave
        ),
        Value
    ) = 0,
    "No cost is allocated."
)
